attribute.name: Database
attribute.description: Connection string, in CORAL syntax: see section 5.3.2.2 in http://pool.cern.ch/coral/currentReleaseDoc/UserGuide.html#Public_API

attribute.name: TopDir
attribute.description: Directory for ROOT files. The UID of the MDAApplication is appended to TopDir.

attribute.name: CoCaPartition
attribute.description: Partition in which the CoCa server is running

attribute.name: MinRunDuration_s
attribute.description: Minimum run duration (in seconds); histograms will not be archived for shorter runs.

attribute.name: ArchiverInitTimeout_s
attribute.description: A maximum delay in seconds which the MDA application may impose to the STOP transition. Exhausting this timeout does not yet mean that archiving failes but just indicates that some histograms are not yet retrieved from the OH service and if the partition is shutdown immediately then those histograms will be lost.

attribute.name: Frequency_LB
attribute.description: Archiving frequency (luminosity blocks). 0 means: archive only at EOR.

attribute.name: CoCaPRIO
attribute.description: Priority for CoCa cache management system Files with lower priority will be deleted before files with higher priority See also CoCaDTC

attribute.name: CoCaDTC
attribute.description: Desired Time in Cache (in seconds) for CoCa cache management system Files older than their DTC will be removed before than files younger than their DTC, irrespective of their priority

attribute.name: CompressionLevel
attribute.description: ROOT TFile compression level (0 = no compression, 9 = max compression)

attribute.name: DeleteAfterSaving
attribute.description: Delete the histograms from the OHS server(s) after registering the file to CoCa

attribute.name: SaveAnnotations
attribute.description: Store IS histogram annotations in ROOT file

attribute.name: Partition
attribute.description: Partition name where OH server is located, empty name means same partition as MDA application

attribute.name: Provider
attribute.description: Regular expression (OHIterator syntax). Only those providers matching this pattern will be considered.

attribute.name: Histograms
attribute.description: Regular expression (OHIterator syntax). Those histograms, whose names match with this pattern, will be archived.

attribute.name: VersionsNumber
attribute.description: Number of histogram versions to be saved (negative value means all).
